tasks.label: build-docs-live
tasks.command: mkdir -p build-docs && cp docs/_static/index_with_redirect.html build-docs/index.html && uv run sphinx-autobuild --port=8338 -c ${workspaceFolder}/docs/ ${workspaceFolder} ${workspaceFolder}/build-docs

tasks.label: build-docs
tasks.command: uv run sphinx-build -j $(nproc) -b html ${workspaceFolder} ${workspaceFolder}/build-docs -c ${workspaceFolder}/docs/ -W && cp docs/_static/index_with_redirect.html build-docs/index.html
